subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Future of Identity Protection
description: A 60-second lesson on The Future of Identity Protection.

hook.text: Biometrics, blockchain IDs, and zero-knowledge proofs may finally make identity theft obsolete.

buildup.text: Decentralized identity systems let you prove who you are without sharing raw personal data.

discovery.text: Zero-knowledge proofs can verify your age or credit without revealing your actual information.

twist.text: But every past security revolution — from SSNs to passwords — was eventually cracked.

climax.text: The future of identity may be safer, but the arms race between protectors and thieves never ends.

punchline.text: Better locks just inspire better lock-picks.

quiz.question: What can zero-knowledge proofs do for identity protection?
options: Verify identity without revealing personal data
